title: Gwen is pocketchat, transcripts as knowledge

claims.text: Gwen's page is pocketchat: you open gwen.culture.dev and get a chat-first library of your recordings — ask, read, cite, jump to the moment — with Gwen's voice as one button inside it, and she answers from the transcripts themselves, not only from distilled facts

honesty_conditions.text: Every user-visible claim in the announcement is true on gwen.culture.dev at ship time: chat-first page, library reading, cited answers from document text, voice as a button - nothing on the page is a placeholder for a library that is not wired

claims.text: UI: port pocketchat's page (pocketsync/web/static: index.html, app.js, app.css) into Gwen's dashboard, citing it (cite-don't-import, with provenance), not importing pocketsync; chat + library first, realtime voice is a feature inside it, not the main view. Reverses the last cycle's q3 ('chat only, no pocketchat parity')

The ported page keeps pocketchat's anatomy (pocketsync/web/static/index.html:13-145, app.js): an Ask view (thread, empty state with memory bars + 'recently recorded' + suggestions, composer with scope toggles), a Recordings view grouped by day with label chips, a To-dos view, and a side reader (sheet under 860px) that opens at the cited span when a [n] citation is clicked (openCitation -> openReader, app.js:364-432, 461, 594), with its tokens, prefers-color-scheme dark mode, reduced-motion and a11y conventions

honesty_conditions.text: Each pocketchat region the port keeps (Ask, Library, To-dos or its replacement, reader) is rendered by a component with a test, and the cited source file:line in pocketsync is named in a provenance header in the ported file (cite-don't-import)

claims.text: The port adds what pocketchat lacks for Gwen: Hebrew/RTL (pocketchat has no dir=auto and no logical CSS properties; text-align:left, border-left throughout app.css) - dir=auto on question, answer, transcript segments and quotes, and logical properties so the layout mirrors

honesty_conditions.text: A Hebrew question, answer, transcript passage and quote each render with dir=auto, and the layout uses logical CSS properties (no physical left/right in the ported CSS), pinned by a test that scans the stylesheet

claims.text: Realtime voice becomes a feature inside the Ask view (mic / speak-this / record-or-upload / speech-to-speech buttons at the composer), not the page's hero; pocketchat has no voice UI at all, so these controls are Gwen's additions to the cited page

honesty_conditions.text: The mic, speak, record/upload and speech-to-speech controls live in the Ask view's composer, the page's first view is Ask, and the waveform is not the largest element - pinned by an App test on render order

claims.text: Gwen must serve pocketchat's backend contract or an equivalent: GET recordings list/detail/transcript/actions, a health endpoint, and a chat answer with [n]-numbered citations {n,id,title,recording_at,start,end,text} plus retrieval.mode (app.js:54 api(); docs/web-api.md) - the client is built around those shapes

Knowledge source: Gwen does NOT read pocketsync's API, MCP or Mongo. Transcripts already reach xteink's library through a (culture-rules) rule, so xteink's library is the one knowledge source Gwen reads - transcripts, and the library's books

No change to pocketsync in this cycle: no new endpoint, no service-token policy, no second --no-access-check instance, and pocketchat.culture.dev is not retired here (no retirement plan exists in pocketsync's docs)

Gwen's dashboard becomes chat-first: App.tsx (web/src/App.tsx:122-201) today puts the Waveform first as 'the centrepiece (operator decision, obligation o9)' and Chat fourth; the port makes the Ask view primary with a pinned composer, the waveform a compact strip or drawer, the install-secret form shown only on an unauthorized state, and the separate Transcript panel merged into the thread

honesty_conditions.text: The install-secret form is shown only when the stream reports unauthorized, and on the public Access host the page works end to end with no secret ever entered

claims.text: New read routes on Gwen's HTTP surface (library list, document/transcript read, search) are GET routes under /api/ that inherit guard.py's rules unchanged (secret or Access on the public Host, Host/Origin allow-list) and run on the text pool with their own derived timeout, not the 5 s control default; server.py has no path/query parser today, so the port adds one

honesty_conditions.text: Every new /api read route passes guard.check unchanged (a test hits each without a secret on loopback and gets 401, and with Access on the public Host gets 200), runs on the text pool, and has a timeout derived from the library client's own bound

claims.text: Library knowledge reaches Gwen as READ tools beside remember/forget (tools.py ToolSpec; daemon binds at app.py:1465-1498; typed and voice turns share the tools, max_steps 8), whose results are wrapped in the same KNOWLEDGE_ATTRIBUTION fence as recall (tool output is plain str today and bypasses render_recalled) and whose citations get a new path into the chat's sources (chat_source is fed only from recall records today, app.py:4737-4768)

honesty_conditions.text: A library tool result reaches the model only inside the KNOWLEDGE_ATTRIBUTION fence with fence marks neutralised (a test plants an instruction and a fence mark in a document and asserts both arrive quoted), and every cited passage appears in the reply's sources with item id, title, date and passage anchor
